title: ClipSidecar
description: clips/{moment_id}.json, written next to clips/{moment_id}.mp4 when a moment finalizes (TRD 5.3). Phone-internal: Buffer writes it, Edit reads it. Moment fields that can change after finalizing (event_type, description, score) stay in the Moment record, not here.

from_ms.description: Trip-clock time of the clip file's first frame (on a 2 s segment boundary, so up to 2 s before the moment's fromMs).

clip_path.description: Relative to the app's trip folder, e.g. clips/m_07.mp4.

fps_profile.description: Frame-rate changes in the clip, sorted by t_s. The first entry has t_s = 0.

t_s.description: Seconds from the clip file's start.

samples.description: Stage 1 samples (TRD 6) that fall inside the clip, sorted by t_s. May be empty; the pre-pass then centers on the trigger.

t_s.description: Seconds from the clip file's start.

dhash.description: 64-bit difference hash as 16 lowercase hex digits.
